notes.title: Hotfix v0.3.0.2891
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players can't save when creating a new game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where FPS dropped after playing for a while.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clients can't restock in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where blueprint a Supply Portal would cause an error.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Thermal Extractor couldn't be built in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Blueprints can now correctly copy the everyday limit of the Supply Portal.[/p][/*][*][p]Blueprints can now correctly copy the filter settings of the Filter Splitter.[/p][/*][*][p]Automated Nurseries in Blueprints will now automatically remember and consume seeds.[/p][/*][*][p]Merchant items can now be purchased with high-tier currency with change included.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized some factory inspection panels.[/p][/*][*][p]Athanor success rate is now applied and displayed correctly after upgrading Alchemy Skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized NPC overhead info display.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the material and color-change effect of the Storage Boxes.[/p][/*][/list]
